_comment: Staged build plan for Bliss. `current_stage` is the knob that makes the build incremental: spec-coverage.py --gate only requires MUST requirements at or below current_stage to be tested, so the project ships working vertical slices instead of an all-or-nothing whole. Advance current_stage by ONE only after the stage's Gate genuinely passes end-to-end through the real `bliss` binary (see ~/git/bureau/bliss/problem.md and §11). Each requirement's stage is its inline [Sn] tag if present, else the stage of the spec file it is defined in (the `files` map below), else unstaged (reported, not gated). Files not listed here are meta (overview/index/glossary/testing) and are not stage-gated.

stages.name: read-print-eval
stages.gate: bliss --eval "(+ 1 2)" prints 3; every core datatype round-trips read->print; a nested arithmetic/list script prints correct results

stages.name: core-evaluator
stages.gate: recursive (fib 30), higher-order list processing, closures with captured state, and non-local exits run correctly through the CLI

stages.name: macros
stages.gate: load a real .lisp file that defines and uses its own macros plus the standard control/binding macros, and run it to a correct result

stages.name: data-sequences-library
stages.gate: a library-heavy program (string/sequence/hash-table manipulation, formatted output) produces correct observable results

stages.name: conditions-clos
stages.gate: programs using user-defined classes/generic functions and condition handling/restarts run correctly end-to-end

stages.name: hotspot-engine
stages.gate: a hot loop is observably promoted through tiers with identical results at each tier; an invalidated speculation deoptimizes and still returns the correct result

stages.name: real-world-selfhost
stages.gate: real ASDF loads (no special-casing of the file) and (uiop:getenv "PATH") returns the process's actual PATH
